questions.prompt: Under the gun posts a straddle to two big blinds. You are next to act. Conceptually you are…

choices.text: The first voluntary actor, in the straddle’s 'under the gun,' not in a normal big blind.

questions.explanation: Do not use a 9-handed UTG chart from the seat that now faces a bigger blind. This app will not deal the straddle for you.

questions.prompt: The straddler has not acted and you hold 72o. Best conceptual default?

choices.text: Fold. A bigger blind does not make trash playable.
Call because a straddle is a limp

questions.explanation: The straddle changes position and price. It does not change hand values that much for junk.

questions.prompt: A bomb pot is dealt to the flop with five players and you have top pair weak kicker. Conceptually…

choices.text: Bet small or check. Ranges are wide and multiway, so weak kickers do not stack off.
Jam because there was no preflop raiser

questions.explanation: No preflop raise means no capped-versus-uncapped story. Nut potential and player count still rule.

questions.prompt: You are all-in and the table asks to run it twice. A sound poker answer is…

choices.text: Either once or twice is fine if the price was right. Running twice does not fix a bad call, and this app will not deal the second board.
You must run it twice or the hand is dead
Refuse because the second board changes the ranking of hands

questions.explanation: Variance changes. The equity of each board does not.
